edges.reason: GOV is read by _collectFee as the fallback fee recipient.
closeAllTrades requires the caller to equal the guardian state variable.
_conversionHelper reads the converter address to delegatecall against it.
_collectFee enforces the fee against the baseFees state variable.
The isOpenForTrades modifier gates multiAssetSwap on openForTrades.
_trade reads market proxies and activity flags from marketRegistry.
_collectFee indexes the affiliates array with the fee affiliate id.
updateSponsoredMarket mutates the sponsoredMarkets array.
updateGuardian writes the guardian state variable.
addAffiliate pushes a new entry into affiliates.
updateAffiliate overwrites an entry of affiliates.
addSponsoredMarket pushes a new entry into sponsoredMarkets.
setBaseFees writes the baseFees state variable.
setOpenForTrades writes the openForTrades flag.
setOpenForFreeTrades writes the openForFreeTrades flag.
closeAllTrades sets openForTrades to false.
closeAllTrades sets openForFreeTrades to false.
setConverter writes the converter address that is later delegatecalled.
setMarketRegistry writes the marketRegistry address.
closeAllTrades checks _msgSender() against guardian, so the caller identity controls access.
_transferFromHelper uses msg.sender as the source of all pulled assets.
_returnDust refunds leftover ETH and tokens to msg.sender.
The assembly refund in _returnDust sends the balance to caller(), i.e. the untrusted sender.
Token dust is transferred to msg.sender inside the dust loop.
msg.sender is encoded as the from address in the unchecked ERC20 transferFrom call.
feeDetails supplies the affiliate index and ETH fee used for indexing and comparison.
Each element of _converstionDetails supplies the bytes passed to the converter delegatecall.
User-supplied conversionData is the calldata executed by the converter delegatecall.
User-supplied tradeDetails.tradeData/value drive the market proxy call/delegatecall.
User-supplied tradeDetails.tradeData is executed via proxy delegatecall for library markets.
dustTokens enumerates the tokens scanned and refunded by _returnDust.
rescueETH forwards the full balance to the recipient parameter.
The recipient parameter reaches the assembly ETH transfer inside _transferEth.
The loop index i iterates over the trade details inside _trade.
multiAssetSwap calls _collectFee before transferring assets.
multiAssetSwap calls _transferFromHelper to pull user assets.
multiAssetSwap calls _conversionHelper to delegatecall the converter.
multiAssetSwap calls _trade to execute market trades.
multiAssetSwap calls _returnDust at the end.
batchBuyWithERC20s calls _conversionHelper.
batchBuyWithERC20s calls _trade.
batchBuyWithERC20s calls _returnDust.
batchBuyWithERC20s inlines the unchecked ERC20 transferFrom call loop.
batchBuyWithETH calls _trade.
_conversionHelper validates the delegatecall result via _checkCallResult.
_trade validates non-OpenSea call results via _checkCallResult.
_collectFee pays the fee through _transferEth.
rescueETH withdraws through _transferEth.
_conversionHelper is the function that performs the converter delegatecall.
_trade performs the library proxy delegatecall.
_trade performs the value-bearing proxy call.
_transferFromHelper contains the unchecked ERC20 transferFrom call.
batchBuyFromOpenSea performs the raw OpenSea proxy call.
_returnDust contains the assembly ETH refund call.
_returnDust contains the token dust transfer call.
_transferEth contains the assembly ETH transfer call.
batchBuyWithETH contains the assembly ETH refund to caller().
Arbitrary code executed via the converter delegatecall can re-enter multiAssetSwap while it is mid-execution.
A malicious library market delegatecall runs in contract context and can call back into multiAssetSwap.
The market proxy call transfers control to an external contract that can re-enter the swap entrypoints.
Untrusted ERC20 token code invoked by the transferFrom call can re-enter batchBuyWithERC20s.
The OpenSea proxy call hands control to an external contract that may re-enter the batch entrypoint.
Untrusted token code triggered during the dust transfer can re-enter batchBuyWithERC20s.
ERC1155 transfers into the contract trigger the onERC1155Received receiver hook.
ERC1155 batch transfers into the contract trigger the onERC1155BatchReceived hook.
ERC721 transfers into the contract trigger the onERC721Received hook.

normalization_plan.reason: feeDetails is only consumed by _collectFee for the affiliate index and fee comparison, so it collapses into that function.
_converstionDetails is the input array iterated by _conversionHelper and carries no independent semantics.
conversionData is the raw payload executed by the converter delegatecall unsafe operation.
tradeDetails is the user data array that drives the market proxy call/delegatecall execution.
dustTokens only parameterizes the leftover-asset refund loop of _returnDust.
recipient is the destination consumed by rescueETH and forwarded to _transferEth.
The loop index i only exists to iterate the trade details inside _trade.
